aircraftCfg._comment: Use aircraft.cfg as high-confidence fallback only when the B788 type designator is paired with Kuro/Kurorin variation evidence.

lvars._comment: The cited Kuro sources do not define a 787-8 custom integration table. This profile inherits the Asobo 787 family profile and keeps SimConnect as the active telemetry path.

controls._comment: No active Kuro 787-8 custom controls are mapped because the cited sources do not define an external-control interface.

meta.notes: Kuro Boeing 787-8 profile for the freeware MSFS add-on that requires the Asobo 787-10 base aircraft. The cited Kuro sources do not define a custom-variable table, so active telemetry and controls remain SimConnect/inherited 787-family behavior.

sources.title: Kuro_B787-8 [Req: MSFS2020 Asobo B787-10 (v1)]
sources.notes: Flightsim.to listing identifies the Kuro_B787-8 add-on and its dependency on the Asobo B787-10 base aircraft. It supports product identity only and does not define custom telemetry or controls.

sources.title: Installer - Headwind Simulations
sources.notes: Headwind's installer page describes installation for Headwind Simulations add-ons. The page did not publish a Boeing 787 custom-variable map, so no Headwind-specific 787 variables were activated.

verification.notes: Add-on identity is documented by the public distribution listing. Active mappings are limited to inherited SimConnect behavior pending a vendor-documented interface and in-sim verification.
